analysis: No concrete security regression found. (1) Qwen4SupportPolicy.swift:40-41 widens validateReasoningContext to the Qwen3.8-27B concrete model IDs (ModelRuntimeRequirements.qwen38ConcreteModelIDs, not visible here). It rejects efforts other than low/medium/xhigh with a deterministic 400-class unsupportedReasoningEffort. This is request validation only and does not touch crypto, attestation or authorization. (2) MediaIngest.swift:283 now calls validateReasoningContext unconditionally on the media path; before, it ran only when preserveTemplateFields was set. This is stricter, not weaker. (3) The error string at MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngineError.swift:111 is now model-generic and carries no request content. (4) MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift lines 1023-1512 arrived as head text with no patch, so the changed lines are unknown. In that excerpt, event-stream release and cancel paths look consistent: makeDeadlineCheckedEventStream (1056-1103) cancels upstream and fires the one-shot release on deadline expiry. The native forwarding path (1381-1395) installs the termination handoff before activation. The nativeMediaTerminalDrain path (1187-1191, 1290-1312) drops late chunks after owner close and fails closed without an engine terminal. These paths bear on T-010 (cancellation propagation), T-007 and billing/usage integrity. Remaining uncertainty: the true diff of the engine file, and the contents of qwen38ConcreteModelIDs and of OneShotRelease/NativeConsumerLease semantics, were not visible. A deeper pass should check that no prompt content appears in the new error paths and that release fires exactly once on every exit.
